svg.title: Tirth Patel | GitHub profile
svg.desc: Tirth Patel, Computer Science student at the University of Regina focused on blue team, SOC and cloud security. Projects: AWS CloudTrail security monitoring and a Wazuh SIEM homelab. GitHub: pateltirth128.
